WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    s.arcref,
    p.fundflux,
    CASE 
      WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
      THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS rate
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
group_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    arcref,
    fundflux,
    AVG(rate) AS group_rate
  FROM scan_rates
  WHERE rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY arcref, fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_rate) AS benchmark_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT 
  gr.arcref,
  gr.fundflux,
  gr.group_rate AS rate,
  (gr.group_rate - b.benchmark_rate) AS excess
FROM group_rates gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE gr.group_rate > b.benchmark_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Scans with gbsize = NULL, spanmin = NULL, or spanmin ≤ 0 are treated as having an undefined or missing ratio and are excluded from group averages, since the ratio (gbsize / spanmin) cannot be computed in these cases.
